factual_entities.name_en: Leh-Ladakh Cold Desert, Changpa Tribe & Pashmina Wool
factual_entities.name_hi: लेह-लद्दाख ठंडा रेगिस्तान, चांगपा जनजाति और पश्मीना शॉल
attributes: Gaurav Jani on motorcycle 'Loner' from Mumbai to Leh Ladakh (Cold desert); Leh houses: 2-storey stone walls coated with mud/lime; windowless ground floor for livestock/winter storage; flat poplar trunk roofs for drying chillies/corn/paddy
Changpa Tribe: Nomadic tribe of ~5000 people living on CHANGTHANG plateau at 5000 METERS; Rebo: Cone-shaped tents of woven yak hair; Lekha: Stone pen for goats/sheep
Pashmina Shawl: From underfur of CHANGTHANGI GOATS living at 5000m and -40°C; 6 PASHMINA HAIRS EQUAL 1 HUMAN HAIR; 1 plain shawl takes 250 HOURS OF HAND WEAVING; as warm as 6 NORMAL SWEATERS
Srinagar Architecture: Houseboats (up to 80 ft), Donga boats, Khatamband (puzzle woodwork on ceiling), Mehraab (arched doorways), Dab (protruding bay windows)

visual_assets_and_diagram_cues: Rebo tent with yak hair strips, Lekha pen, Khatamband ceiling puzzle, Mehraab arch, Dab window

key_vocabulary_bilingual.Leh Houses: लेह के दो मंजिला पत्थर के घर (निचली मंजिल पर खिड़की नहीं)
key_vocabulary_bilingual.Pashmina Shawl: पश्मीना शॉल (6 स्वेटर के बराबर गर्म, 250 घंटे बुनाई, 6 गुना पतला बाल)
key_vocabulary_bilingual.Khatamband: खत्मबंद (छत पर जिग्सॉ पहेली जैसी नक्काशी)

ncert_source_text_summary: Class 5 Chapter 13: 'A Shelter so High!' / 'बसेरा ऊँचाई पर' covers Unit 4: Shelter, Architecture & Climatic Adaptations foundational facts, regional adaptations, and ecological concepts.
